subject: Forcing reactive expressions to execute in a fixed order

messages.author: 8694449f23a13aa2
messages.subject: Forcing reactive expressions to execute in a fixed order
parts:
Sorry for maybe a silly and badly expressed question, but: is there any way to force two or more endpoints depending on the same reactive expression to execute in a fixed order?

Here is my code:
a <- reactive (
  #executes some external function based on a user input
)
 
x <- renderX({
  #does something with a: short running time
})
y <- renderY
({
  #does something with a: long running time
})

What I am trying to do is to display the results of x as soon as possible, without waiting for y to finish (as is the case now). As I suppose it may have to do with http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/execution-scheduling.html and the paragaph which reads: "If a flush occurs when multiple endpoints are invalidated, there isn’t a guaranteed order that the endpoints will execute...", but there is no hint as to if this behaviour can be modified. I have tried to nest y in x, but it does not work either.
Will be grateful for any help,
Tom

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Forcing reactive expressions to execute in a fixed order
parts: (I assume x and y are outputs.) It's possible using outputOptions, which has a priority parameter. However, it probably won't give you what you want: even if x executes before y, none of the results are actually sent to the client until they have all completed. I thought it looked confusing to the user otherwise.
